post.description: Create a booking owned by the authenticated user. A required UUID Idempotency-Key is scoped to that user and retained with booking history without automatic expiry. The same normalized request replays the original 201 body, including after cancellation. A changed payload returns IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH. REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS or BOOKING_BUSY means retry the same key and payload after a short delay. After timeout or 503, reconcile by repeating the same key and payload; never generate a new key for an uncertain result. Validation/conflict failures roll back and do not consume the key.
